Now, in the absence of these deities, the shrine has become a haven for the [[Charr Shaman]] caste. An entrance at the shrine leads to a sprawling complex beneath known as the [[Cathedral of Flames]]. }} == Getting there == *Travel Northeast through [[Grothmar Wardowns]] into Dalada Uplands during the quest [[The Dawn of Rebellion]] and defeat [[Scorch Maulclaw]] to gain entrance. *If at least one character in the party has already turned in [[The Dawn of Rebellion]], the portal will be open and can be run to normally, starting from [[Longeye's Ledge]] and heading east through [[Grothmar Wardowns]] and [[Dalada Uplands]]. Otherwise (even if the quest is completed but not yet turned in), the portal will be absent, replaced by a closed gate. Also note that entering Doomlore Shrine in this manner will not automatically complete the quest [[The Dawn of Rebellion]] for you. ==Quests available== *[[Gron Fierceclaw]] **[[Temple of the Damned]] {{quest icon|Repeatable}} **[[Veiled Threat]] {{quest icon|Repeatable}} *[[Bonwor Fierceblade]] **[[What Must Be Done]] {{quest icon|primary}} **[[Assault on the Stronghold]] {{quest icon|primary}} {{quest icon|repeatable}} ==NPCs== ===Services=== *{{x}} 20 [[Swift Fiercejustice]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Superb Charr Carving]]s) *{{a}} 20 [[Gron Fierceclaw]] ([[merchant]], mission starter) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) *{{x}} 10 [[Zaishen Scout]] ([[Embark Beach]]) *{{x}} 20 [[Dune Teardrinker]] ([[Polymock opponent]]) =====Henchmen===== :''(all level 20)'' *{{w}} [[Devona]] (Fighter) *{{w}} [[Talon Silverwing]] (Guardian) *{{r}} [[Aidan]] (Archer) *{{r}} [[Zho]] (Interrupt) *{{mo}} [[Lina]] (Protection) *{{mo}} [[Mhenlo]] (Healer) *{{n}} [[Eve]] (Blood) *{{me}} [[Lo Sha]] (Illusion) *{{e}} [[Cynn]] (Fire) *{{e}} [[Herta]] (Earth) ===Other allies=== *{{w}} 20 [[Bonwor Fierceblade]] ==Notes== {{gw2w|Doomlore Ruins}} *Exploring Doomlore Shrine will yield less than 1 Eye of the North mastery point *It doesn't contain all of the NPC services of a town, instead it has all the NPCs of a [[mission outpost]]. *It is also the only [[outpost]] in the [[Charr Homelands]]. {{Towns and outposts in the Charr Homelands}}
